title: Count Evens up to n
statement: Write a function `countEvensUpTo(n)` that counts how many even whole numbers exist between 1 and n. Use a `for` loop.
prewrittenHints: An even number leaves remainder zero when divided by two.
Increment a counter variable by one whenever an even is encountered.
Yield the accumulated count after finishing the loop.
conceptNote: Counting increments a variable by 1, whereas summing adds the value itself.
